## Checklist

- [ ] `just check` passes locally.
- [ ] Tests cover the change (unit, property or integration as appropriate).
- [ ] Algorithms cite their source and are scored against simulated ground truth.
- [ ] Docs updated (reference, how-to or README) where users are affected.
- [ ] Schemas and data contracts updated first; breaking changes are versioned.
- [ ] No secrets, no personal data, no data files committed; data budgets respected.
- [ ] No machine learning or model APIs added (ADR-0002).
- [ ] Does this change a recorded decision or add a technology? If yes, an ADR is added or
      superseded in `docs/adr/`.
- [ ] `ROADMAP.md` ticked if this completes an item.
